subject: Post-demo: Redwood Inference + NovusFin — next steps & security kickoff
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novusfin.com>, Michael Young <myoung@novusfin.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Redwood Inference + NovusFin — next steps & security kickoff

Hi Elena / Michael —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Confirm economic sponsor and procurement contact (who will review price/SOW).
2) Kick off security intake so our security team can scope systems and run a short questionnaire.
3) Provide any existing security questionnaire or SOC2/PCI artifacts early (we can sign an NDA if needed).
4) Tentative timeline: security intake this week -> procurement review next week -> pricing/SOW draft by end of next week.

Attached: novusfin-security-questionnaire.xlsx (your internal questionnaire you mentioned); I also attached our short intake form to speed the scope call.

Can you confirm who needs to be on the procurement/legal thread and whether external data sources (data warehouse connectors, external vendor APIs) should be included in the security scope?

If helpful, Kimberly is ready to join a 30-min scope call tomorrow afternoon PST to walk through the intake and systems boundary. Priyom (solutions engineer) will shadow the call for technical questions.

Suggested meeting windows (PT): Mon 5/25 10:00-11:00, 14:00-15:00; Tue 5/26 09:00-10:00. If none work, propose what does.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0112
[Attachment: novusfin-security-questionnaire.xlsx (XLSX, 92KB)]
[Attachment: redwood-security-intake-form.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novusfin.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Young <myoung@novusfin.com>, procurement@novusfin.com
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Redwood Inference + NovusFin — next steps & security kickoff

Thanks Aditya — great session.

Quick answers: Michael (myoung@novusfin.com) is the economic sponsor (CFO). Procurement is procurement@novusfin.com and should be looped on any pricing/SOW communication. 

On scope: please include the following in the security intake:
- Our production data warehouse (Redshift cluster: redshift-prod.novusfin.internal)
- ETL pipeline running in our AWS account (Glue + Fargate tasks)
- Any connectors that will query customer PII (we will mark those schemas and can supply a list)
- Third-party vendor APIs (e.g., vendor-data.io) that we may hit for enrichment — would like to understand if Redwood stores any transitive data from those calls.

I attached our standard questionnaire; it has a few fields pre-filled. Can Kimberly confirm whether third-party connector behaviour is treated as in-scope (i.e., do you need access to vendor configs or only details about API calls and data retention)?

We can do the scope call Tuesday 5/26 09:00 PT.

Elena
Senior Product Ops, NovusFin
elena.torres@novusfin.com
[Attachment: novusfin-security-questionnaire.xlsx (XLSX, 92KB)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novusfin.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Redwood Inference + NovusFin — next steps & security kickoff

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Quick clarifications ahead of the call: 

- Third-party connectors: treated as in-scope to the extent they are part of the request path. We do not require vendor credentials, but we will need examples of the API surface (endpoints called, request/response payloads) and confirmation whether any vendor responses are stored persistently.

- Redshift and ETL: we will want a high-level diagram (we can accept a 1-page architecture PDF) showing where the model inference requests originate and which networks/subnets the services run in.

- PII schemas: a list of schemas/tables flagged as PII is perfect. If you can redline or mark sample rows, that accelerates review.

Attached is our short intake form pre-filled with a few follow-up questions so we can scope the right level of assurance. 

We can keep the 09:00 PT slot tomorrow (Tue 5/26). I'll plan to use the first 15 minutes for scope and deliverables, then Priyom can jump into technical details for the rest. 

Checklist for the call (so we align):
- Confirm econ sponsor and procurement contact (noted: Michael + procurement@novusfin.com)
- Agree systems in-scope (Redshift, ETL, connectors, vendor APIs)
- Deliverables and timeline (intake -> doc request -> 48-72h security review -> summary + SOC2 ask)
- Identify any PO/contract dependencies for Dedicated capacity vs hosted trial

See attached: redwood-security-intake-form.pdf.

Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood-security-intake-form.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

From: Michael Young <myoung@novusfin.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@novusfin.com>
Cc: procurement@novusfin.com, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Redwood Inference + NovusFin — next steps & security kickoff

Thanks everyone — appreciate the clear plan. I authorize the security intake next steps and the proposed timeline. A couple asks from my side before we proceed: 

- Please send any SOC2 summary or attestation and our procurement team will kick off any contract review (we have a standard NDA and MSA template).
- Can Redwood provide a draft SOW and ballpark pricing for a 6-month pilot (hosted API, expected ~200K tokens/day) so procurement has numbers for the internal review?

Aditya — if you can share SOC2 summary and a SOW draft by Friday 5/29, procurement will aim to turn around redlines within a week.

Michael Young
CFO | NovusFin
myoung@novusfin.com | +1 (212) 555-0189
[Attachment: novusfin-internal-legal-contacts.txt (TXT, 1KB)]
